executionBlocker.requiredCapability: A purpose-specific x402 client backed by an isolated low-value signer/wallet. The LLM must not receive or reveal a raw private key. The layer must parse live 402 terms, enforce Base + USDC for the initial cohort, approved host/method allowlists, per-call/session/founder budget caps, task/endpoint/recipient/amount binding, replay protection, audit receipts, and a kill switch before signing.
executionBlocker.recommendedImplementation: Use an x402-compatible managed wallet/MCP or isolated signer exposing only bounded purchase operations. Initial cohort: You.com GET /v1/search at US$0.005 and Tavily POST /search at US$0.01. Do not assume testnet availability: You.com explicitly documents mainnet-only x402 and says the first successful call spends real funds. Fund the dedicated operating wallet only with the bounded benchmark allowance. Never place a general-purpose wallet private key in James prompts, repository files, logs, Airtable, Drive, or agent-readable configuration.
